entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • <script type="module" src="..."> is fetched twice in published MVC apps when importmap is present #66553
  • Revise obsolete APIs intended to be removed, and consider removing in .NET 11 #66551
  • Investigate redesign of public types to unions #66549
    .NET 11 Planning

    .NET 11 Planning

    .NET 11 Planning

    11.0.0

    11.0.0

    11.0.0

Closed

  • [ppc64le] NU1101 restore failure in BasicLinkedApp / LinkabilityChecker #66375
  • Perf improvement: json #66535
  • jQuery on NuGet is still v3.7.1 even though 4.0.0 is the latest #65879
  • Virtualize: viewport stability on prepend regresses when items are inserted while the user is still within the initial render window (`_itemsBefore == 0`) #66541
